name: switch
useFor: Use to turn a setting or a channel on and off immediately (Phone Number, iMessage, Agent2Agent in Create Agent Identity). Put the label at the left and the switch at the right of the row, and give the switch an accessible name with aria-label or a Label. Use size sm in dense lists.
constraints: A switch that needs a save button to apply
A colored track other than purple when on
source: Figma 427:2715: Toggle (44 by 24) in the channel cards of Create Agent Identity, off and on states in Modal States
title: Switch
description: A 44 by 24 pill: off gray, purple when on, with a white knob that slides across.
